description: red de incendios is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cabildo Insular de La Palma. Information is available on the Firefighting Network, pumping stations, Wastewater Treatment Plants (WWTPs), Rafts and Dams, Emissaries, Main pipelines, which serve to have a notion of global water balances in the La Palma Hydrographic District. Coverage: Cabildo Insular de La Palma. The portal shows the English title as "Fire Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cabildo Insular de La Palma. Its keywords include hidrologia, conduccion, medio-ambiente, canales, la palma, ods6. The listing shows 2017-05-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.opendatalapalma.es/pages/avisolegal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
